verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's marketing page says you can design, run, and analyze tests and rollouts alongside your analytics. Its API docs describe a Feature Flags API that assigns users to experiment variants. That evidences running A/B experiments, but nothing documents how results are reported. Missing for 10: documentation of goal/primary metric configuration for experiments, statistical significance or confidence reporting on results, an in-depth experiment-report doc, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
